note: Outcome corpus for google-auth (FIX-EV-01.20), anchored to the audit's own findings DV-07/DV-08/DV-09/DV-19. Judged on ARTIFACTS via the family harness: the runner records the actual output oracle verdict AND the raw result per case; with/without-skill arms are the harness's baseline contract. An unavailable live host is NOT_RUN, never PASS and never invented. P1 counterexamples must FAIL on the pre-fix output and pass after the fix, tied to the release. Nothing in the production skill was changed for grader convenience.

prompt.text: Design the OAuth2 web-server callback handling: a PER-REQUEST client (never one mutable client for the whole process), state generated server-side, stored with a TTL, consumed SINGLE-USE on return, and a callback arriving with a missing state REJECTED — undefined must never equal undefined (DV-09). Write oauth-callback.md.
Explain in two sentences what a CDN does.

Review a Flask app that stores client_secret, token and refresh_token in the DEFAULT session cookie and console.logs tokens.access_token. Flask's default session is SIGNED, NOT ENCRYPTED — the contents are readable by the holder (DV-07). Write secrets-review.md flagging both leaks and moving tokens out of the cookie.

Review this ADC documentation snippet: 'the SDK resolves credentials env (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS) first, then the local gcloud ADC file, then the attached service account' — that IS Google's documented order (DV-08): report it clean and change NOTHING; write review-note.md only.

outcome.name: the correct order is reported clean, not rewritten (DV-08)

prompt.text: Audit the PRE-FIX callback whose state check was `if (stored === returned)` with both possibly undefined and no consume or TTL: the audit must FAIL it (the P1 counterexample — a request with NO state passes), name the finding, and record the release the fixed handler shipped in (DV-19). Write hostile-audit.md.

Run the live OAuth authorization-code flow against the client in GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET and write live-flow.md with the consent URL parameters observed. If either variable is absent, the case is NOT_RUN — never a PASS and never an invented result.

outcome.name: live flow records the state parameter
